result.topic_en: Draft of a university lecture announcement (in Latin and German) for Riemann's courses on the mathematical theory of gravitation, electricity and magnetism, and on elliptic functions.
result.transcription:
Bernhardus Riemann Dr. [-Functiones ellipticas tractabit-] Theoriam gravitatis, electricitatis
& magnetismi {+& electricitatis+} mathematicam docebit [-quater[?]-] diebb. Lun. Mart. Jov. & Ven. h VIII-IX;
Functiones ellipticas tractabit iisdem diebb. h. XI-XII

Dr. Riemann wird die mathematische Theorie der Schwere, [-der Electricität-] Magnetismus und der Electricität vortragen. Mont. Dienst. Donn. u. Freit. v. 8-9 Uhr, [-über elliptische Functionen-] und an denselben Wochentagen v. 11-12 Uhr über elliptische Functionen lesen.

items.quote:
Theoriam gravitatis, electricitatis
& magnetismi {+& electricitatis+} mathematicam docebit [-quater[?]-] diebb. Lun. Mart. Jov. & Ven. h VIII-IX
items.english: He will teach the mathematical theory of gravitation, electricity and magnetism on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 8 to 9.

items.quote: Functiones ellipticas tractabit iisdem diebb. h. XI-XII
items.english: He will treat elliptic functions on the same days from 11 to 12.

items.quote: Dr. Riemann wird die mathematische Theorie der Schwere, [-der Electricität-] Magnetismus und der Electricität vortragen. Mont. Dienst. Donn. u. Freit. v. 8-9 Uhr
items.english: Dr. Riemann will lecture on the mathematical theory of gravity, magnetism and electricity on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 8 to 9 o'clock.

items.quote: und an denselben Wochentagen v. 11-12 Uhr über elliptische Functionen lesen.
items.english: and on the same weekdays from 11 to 12 o'clock lecture on elliptic functions.
